description: The United Kingdom Generic Distribution System, UKGDS, is a set of power network models representative of UK distribution networks, developed by the Centre for Sustainable Electricity and Distributed Generation (SEDG). The README of the GitHub copy read on 2026-09-26 says the original SEDG links were broken in April 2015, so the repository is an unofficial home for the models until the resources return or SEDG asks for removal. Phase 1 models include EHV1, a 33 kV rural network fed from 132 kV with long lines and a sub-sea cable, EHV2, a large rural network with three 33 kV sub-networks, EHV3, a mostly radial suburban network, EHV4, a meshed suburban network, and EHV5, a meshed urban network with direct 132/11 kV transformation, each as an Excel file with a network diagram. Coverage is generic UK distribution networks, not real feeders. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): no licence issued (repository README: no licence for the UKGDS resources has been issued by SEDG). Caveats: the copy is unofficial and unmaintained, and the models date from the original project. Simulation uses are power flow and hosting capacity planning for distributed generation on typical UK networks. Related records: data-reds-repository-distribution-systems links the UKGDS, and data-simbench is a maintained set of benchmark grids for Germany.
